name: Zillillium Rimonite
source:
[spoiler]Singer: [url=/s788]Noriko Mitose[/url][/spoiler]

A genius researcher aligned with the Chimon faction who aims to create a world where everyone lives in harmony as Sharl-like creatures that lack individual free will. She will stop at nothing to achieve her goals.

[spoiler]She is in love with Undu, a researcher who currently inhabits Nero's body after he lost his in an accident. Her secondary goal is to rescue him.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://pastebin.com/egW4rhTK]Ciel Nosurge Summary[/url]]
